questions.text:
In Java, after executing the following code what are the values of x, y and z?
int x, y=10; z=12;
x=y++ + z++;
questions.solution:
Post-increment uses the old values first: x = 10 + 12 = 22. Then y becomes 11 and z becomes 13.

Answer: x = 22, y = 11, z = 13
